narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**1291 hits, 94 files. Most are safe. Five zones are not.**

| Zone | Hits | Rename |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS names | ~1050 | yes |
| SQL column text in `repo/*.js` | 125 | no |
| Stored payload key `{...values, account_id}` | 25 | no |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | no, applied history |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | no, frozen contract |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | no, regenerated |
| `WIRE` map in `lib/serialize.js` | 5 | no, both sides |

The trap is [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8). Its key reads the DB row. Its value is the public field. Unknown row keys pass through raw.

Next: ask them to prove `WIRE`, SQL text, and payload keys stay untouched.
